d: The long-running TVS family dispute has escalated into a legal battle, with Lakshmi Venu approaching the Madras High Court over the division of joint family assets. The case has brought the Venu Srinivasan family, inheritance rights under the Hindu Succession Act and the 2020 family arrangement into focus. Key interests linked to TVS Holdings, TVS Motor Company, TVS Credit Services and Sundaram-Clayton are among the assets at the centre of the dispute. Watch.
